notes_for_editor: Only OpenStreetMap and the Wikipedia community page were read. Record county is null, and no source read places the tower in Pike County; the story only says the name matches that community. Two pages that name the tower (an Anyplace America topo page and a Chamber of Commerce listing) returned HTTP 403, and search snippets hint at a telecom use that I could not check, so they are not used. The Central US Lookouts Arkansas index has no Kirby entry. Nothing found on builder, date or purpose; the OSM observation tag may not mean a fire lookout.
